priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: At current head 367883f4761b177ea732ce673a23a72165c23f7b, src/socket.ts line 2 still registers handler with socket.on("message", handler), while the changed disposer at line 3 is a no-op. The base implementation called socket.off("message", handler), so cleanup remains broken.
